jobs.occupation: Reach Truck Driver - Logent (Evergem / region Ghent, Belgium)
jobs.description:
• Safely operating reach trucks to maneuver, stack, retrieve, and store palletized goods in high-bay warehouse racks.  
•   
Handling inbound and outbound freight trucks with precision to guarantee damage-free logistics handling.
    
•   
Performing visual quality inspections on incoming goods, reporting discrepancies or damage promptly to the warehouse supervisor.
    
•   
Replenishing pick faces and staging inventory for order pickers to prevent bottlenecks.
    
•   
Maintaining clean aisles, adhering strictly to occupational safety protocols, and conducting daily pre-shift reach truck checks.
   
  
•   
You hold a valid reach truck driver certificate / license (reachtruckattest) and have hands-on driving experience.
    
•   
Fluent communication skills in English (working knowledge of Dutch is an asset) to ensure safety on the work floor and clear team communication.
    
•   
You have reliable personal transport (car, motorcycle, or electric bike) to reach our facility in Evergem independently, matching early/late or night shift schedules.
    
•   
You are available for a 2-shift rotation or a fixed night shift and align with our collective closure schedule (3 weeks in late July/early August and the Christmas/New Year holiday period).

Our client is a well-established retail organization operating a large network of specialized stores across Belgium. With a strong focus on customer service and operational excellence, the company relies on robust IT solutions to support its stores and central services. To support ongoing growth and digital transformation initiatives, our client is looking for an IT Onsite Support to strengthen its IT team.

Jobomschrijving

As an IT Onsite Support, you will play a key role in supporting both store operations and corporate services. Acting as a first point of contact for IT-related issues, you will help ensure the smooth functioning of business-critical systems while contributing to continuous improvement initiatives:

• Provide 1st and 2nd line IT support to stores and central services, primarily remotely and occasionally on-site.
• Monitor the performance and availability of Point-of-Sale (POS) systems and coordinate issue resolution with internal or external stakeholders.
• Ensure accurate ticket logging, tracking, and follow-up through the company's service desk platform.
• Contribute to the maintenance and enhancement of POS and ERP-related functionalities.
• Create, update, and maintain user documentation and operational procedures.
• Participate in the development and enrichment of the internal knowledge base.
• Identify potential risks, recurring issues, and opportunities for process improvement.
• Support testing activities and system enhancements as your expertise develops.

• Strong motivation to learn and develop expertise in business applications and IT systems.
• Hands-on, proactive mindset with a customer-focused approach.
• Ability to work collaboratively while taking ownership of assigned tasks.
• Open to feedback and continuous improvement.
• Experience with Microsoft Dynamics NAV / Business Central is mandatory.
• Experience within a retail environment is a plus.
• Fluent in Dutch. French & English are an advantage.
• Willing to participate in an on-call rotation system (with appropriate compensation).
• Eager to learn and grow within a dynamic team environment.

Our client, an international company operating in the manufacturing sector, is looking for a Customer Service Representative to join its customer-facing team.

You will work closely with Sales, Supply Chain, Logistics, and Production teams to guarantee smooth order processing and timely deliveries.Key Responsibilities

• Coordinate with internal stakeholders to ensure efficient order fulfillment.
• Monitor delivery schedules and proactively communicate any changes or delays.

• Support continuous improvement initiatives related to customer service processes.

Personal Skills

• Proactive and solution-oriented.
• Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

For an international organization within the medical sector based in Ghent, we are looking for an experienced Accountant to support the financial management of the Belgian operations. In this varied role, you will take broad responsibility for a range of financial and accounting processes.

Your responsibilities:

• You will manage the full accounting cycle (A to Z) for the Belgian entity and its related holding structure.
• You will be responsible for both general and analytical accounting, ensuring the accuracy and quality of financial data.
• You will act as the main point of contact for accounting and financial matters within the organization.
• You will handle monthly and annual closings and ensure accurate and timely financial reporting.
• You will prepare annual accounts and various statutory and tax filings, including VAT, Intrastat and statistical reporting.
• You will monitor outstanding receivables and payables and process payments and payroll-related accounting entries.
• You will work closely with external partners and advisors on tax matters, subsidies and other financial topics.
• You will support the annual audit process and act as a key contact during financial audits.
• You will contribute to budgeting, forecasting and variance analysis, helping to identify and explain deviations from financial targets.
• You will perform balance sheet reconciliations and controls, ensuring that discrepancies are identified and followed up appropriately.
• You will actively contribute to the improvement and optimization of financial processes, systems and procedures, working closely with the corporate finance team.

About you:

• You hold a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics or a related field.
• You have at least 10 years of relevant experience in accounting.
• You have a strong knowledge of general and analytical accounting.
• Experience in an international or corporate environment is considered an advantage.
• You have an excellent command of Dutch and English, both written and spoken.
• You have strong analytical skills and a keen eye for detail.
• You are independent, proactive and solution-oriented, while also being a strong team player.
• You are able to set priorities and maintain a high level of accuracy, even when working under tight deadlines.
• You are IT-minded and comfortable working with ERP systems and Excel.

The Top Line
 

Here’s the deal. We’re all about helping researchers break free from tools that just don’t cut it. Unleashing problem-tackling solutions that make a huge difference in the real science they do every day. That’s our mantra, our promise and we own it. Our tribe is different. We thrive on moving fast, taking risks and persevering through failure. We embrace the unknown and we are happy to make mistakes. We are there for each other and we crave diversity because we know that building a truly diverse tribe will make us better at everything.
 

The Job
 

Come work with an all-star product development team to make tools that solve our customers’ most pressing needs. Work on a wide range of products and technologies, right from the early stages all the way to the final launch, developing cool solutions and overcoming technical challenges along the way. Get gritty: determine what the system needs, run tests, troubleshoot problems and make things work. You will be part of a small team that covers all the different disciplines that come into play when developing a new instrument (hardware, software, science, algorithms, etc.). This is a great opportunity to work in a fun and challenging environment where you can make a real impact.
 

Responsibilities
 
 

• Work with mechanical designers on prototyping and developing new hardware 

• Build small software tools to help test or calibrate the hardware 

• Work closely with the manufacturing engineer to support the transfer to production 

• Report progress in weekly meetings 

• Be ready to be part of a multidisciplinary team and contribute wherever you can  

Qualifications
 
 

• Master or equivalent in Engineering field 

• Exceptional problem-solving skills 

• Analytical mindset 

• Fluent in Dutch and English 

• Experience in programming or strong will to learn 

• LabVIEW experience/knowledge is an asset but not required 

• SolidWorks/Onshape knowledge are a plus 

• Excellent documentation, organizational, teamwork, troubleshooting, problem solving, and communication skills  

Location and Compensation
 

This is a full-time, onsite position in Ghent, Belgium. The gross monthly salary range is €4,000–€5,000, depending on experience and level. Benefits include €10 meal vouchers, medical insurance and group insurance.

We are looking for an additional production worker within the cladding department.

Salary: 17.912 euro bruto / hour   1.2497 euro bruto/ hour extra shiftpremie or 4.16556 euro bruto/ hour in de fix night   4.5 euro mealvouchers per day.

Duties:

- You are responsible for inserting and removing the profiles in the machine.

- You assist the operator in a smooth start-up of the production line and support him/her when the process needs to be adjusted.

- Together with the operator you monitor the continuity and quality of the process and follow up on the operator's instructions.

You have had your first experience in production.

You can hold an interview in English.

You can work in 2 shifts or nightshift

Company

Founded in Belgium in 1935, our client has grown into an international leader in sustainable packaging solutions. Their packaging—from corrugated cardboard and solid board to tubes and protective corners—is produced with recycled paper and is 100% recyclable and biodegradable. With a long-term vision and focus on sustainability, they combine ecological and economic progress. Their products, relationships, and management style all contribute to a greener planet. Today, our client has 6,500 employees, spread across 70 locations in 21 countries. The headquarters is located in Aalst.

Jobomschrijving

For the location in Hoogstraten, our client is looking for enthusiastic operators.

Curious about how paper and cardboard are made? With our client, you will learn it all!

As an operator, you play a crucial role in the production process. These are your responsibilities:

• Setting up, operating, and monitoring machines for the production of paper and cardboard products.
• Starting and stopping machines according to prescribed procedures.
• Performing quality checks on products during the production process.
• Ensuring a smooth production process with your colleagues.
• Performing first-line maintenance on the machines.
• Reporting technical malfunctions and working with the technical department to resolve them.
Monitoring the safety instructions and ensuring they are applied in the workplace

Eager to learn and interested in growth opportunities? Then you are the operator our client is looking for!

• Working in a production environment doesn’t scare you, even if it’s noisy.
• You are a handy person with an interest in technology.
• You value safety, order, cleanliness, and quality.
• You are open to feedback and see it as an opportunity to grow.
• You demonstrate responsibility and are always ready to help others.
• You have basic PC skills.
• You will be employed in a 2-shift or 5-shift system.
• You speak good Dutch or English.

We are looking for a Corporate Accounting Expert to strengthen a finance team in Groot-Bijgaarden. In this role, you will support the Accounting Manager and contribute to the quality, accuracy and timely delivery of accounting and financial reporting activities. You will also act as a point of reference for the accounting team and support colleagues with complex or non-routine matters.

Your responsibilities:

• Coordinate the administration related to invoices and commitments, including leasing, housekeeping, payroll, real estate taxes and travel expenses.
• Monitor relevant expenditures against budget and follow up with external parties such as suppliers, municipalities and surveyors when required.
• Coordinate the external audit process and prepare or review audit documentation and samples.
• Review account reconciliations, including accruals, prepayments and suspense accounts, as well as payroll reconciliations in cooperation with the Payroll Manager.
• Contribute to month-end closing and management reporting by analysing account movements and explaining significant fluctuations.
• Ensure accurate intercompany accounting and recharges.
• Coordinate VAT, real estate tax and other relevant tax compliance activities together with the Tax department.
• Support budgeting activities and the preparation and review of statutory accounts.
• Contribute to financial reporting for subsidiaries in line with IFRS and local GAAP.
• Support accounting activities related to mergers, acquisitions and entity integrations.
• Coordinate local GAAP accounting memos where required.
• Ensure appropriate accounting procedures, controls and systems are implemented and followed.
• Participate in European finance projects, including system implementations, entity integrations, IFRS migrations and updates to policies and procedures.
• Contribute to process improvements and other ad-hoc finance projects.
• Support the Accounting Manager in guiding the Corporate Accounting team and provide advice on non-routine accounting matters.
• Help onboard and train new and existing team members.

Your profile:

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics or equivalent professional experience.
• At least 5 years of accounting experience.
• Solid experience preparing financial statements.
• Experience within a services or retail environment.
• Strong knowledge of IFRS and local GAAP.
• Experience with CRM/ERP migration or upgrade projects, particularly UAT, key-user or training responsibilities.
• SAP experience is required; knowledge of SAP S/4HANA is an advantage.
• Experience in a multi-country or shared-services environment is a plus.
• Previous management experience is an advantage.
• Fluent in English and French. German is considered a strong asset, while additional market languages are a plus.
• Good knowledge of Microsoft applications and advanced Excel skills.

Our customer is a leading international company active in the development, production, and distribution of high-quality products for the dental industry. They are looking for a Transport Officer. 

As a Transport Officer, you will be responsible for organizing and monitoring transport activities to ensure timely, cost-effective, and high-quality deliveries

Your Responsibilities

• Excellent command of Dutch and English; knowledge of French is a plus.
• Advanced user of Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, Word, and Outlook.

• Strong communication and organizational skills.
